verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs say its dedicated native PostgreSQL database comes with backups and point-in-time recovery (PITR), which covers the core of the story for that database type. Coverage rests on a single line, and nothing shows backup or PITR for the managed shared-pool databases, storage files, or self-hosted deployments. Missing for 10: detailed backup/PITR documentation (schedules, retention, restore workflow), evidence covering managed (non-dedicated) databases and self-hosted instances, independent or hands-on corroboration.
